description: The golden corpus for the transport-error.v1 wire contract. The accept fixtures are the transport's own answers (a Go test renders each code with httpapi.WriteError and compares). No client-only rule: the envelope has no field a schema cannot check.

accept.why: The transport's not_found answer, as httpapi.WriteError renders it (TestTransportErrorGoldensAreWhatTheTransportWrites).
The transport's method_not_allowed answer, as httpapi.WriteError renders it (TestTransportErrorGoldensAreWhatTheTransportWrites).
The transport's payload_too_large answer, as httpapi.WriteError renders it (TestTransportErrorGoldensAreWhatTheTransportWrites).
The transport's rate_limited answer, as httpapi.WriteError renders it (TestTransportErrorGoldensAreWhatTheTransportWrites).
The transport's invalid_request answer, as httpapi.WriteError renders it (TestTransportErrorGoldensAreWhatTheTransportWrites).
The transport's internal_error answer, as httpapi.WriteError renders it (TestTransportErrorGoldensAreWhatTheTransportWrites).

reject.why: A code outside the closed set.
Dependency text in the message: exactly what the fixed texts exist to exclude.
An extra member echoing the request path.
No request id: auth-service always mints one.
A client-chosen id: auth-service never reuses one.
